title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging for residency
author: Ava Singh
description: This PR enforces KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 policies and strengthens audit logging for data residency decisions. Motivation: customers in regulated regions require strong guarantees that keys and decrypted material never leave pinned regions, and we must emit deterministic audit events for every residency check to satisfy compliance teams. Changes include: 1) policy evaluation updates to treat `kms_region` as a first-class residency constraint, 2) a runtime enforcement layer in the KMS integration that rejects requests that violate pinned-region policies, 3) expanded audit events (residency.check -> residency.decision with reason and policy_version), 4) migration of existing RBAC policy fixtures and docs, and 5) integration tests and e2e scenarios for Dedicated/Private installers. Rollout plan: feature-flag gated (rbac_v2_kms_region_pinning) with a gradual canary to 10% traffic, followed by full enable after 48h smoke checks. Backwards compatibility: default behaviour remains permissive unless org policies opt into region pinning. Checklist: - [x] policy validator + evaluator updates - [x] KMS plugin enforcement - [x] audit event schema + emitter - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] docs and migration notes - [x] feature flag and rollout config Notes for reviewers: pay attention to the audit schema change (residency.decision) and the performance impact in the KMS plugin (added a small cache of policy decisions to avoid repeated PDP hits). Linear tickets: ENG-9421, SEC-318.

release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 policies (opt-in via feature flag). Adds detailed residency.decision audit events and a new KMS_REGION_PIN_VIOLATION error code. Backwards compatible unless org policy pinning is enabled.
testing_notes: Unit: policy validator coverage added for kms_region edge cases
Integration: simulated cross-region key usage rejected with KMS_REGION_PIN_VIOLATION
E2E: private installer smoke validated that feature flag disables enforcement by default
Performance: policy decision cache reduces PDP roundtrips; measured <2% p50 latency increase under heavy load in local perf canary
